A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GUI-Critic-R1. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and can be matched despite rearrangement.

before.justification: v1 reports original static GUI evaluations, AndroidWorld experiments, ablations and parameter analyses, including supplementary results in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and supplementary AndroidWorld results, with corrections to some ablation entries.

M1.justification: The data-generation pipeline, RFT cold-start, S-GRPO objectives and rewards, and pre-operative inference procedure remain unchanged. Replacing 'Gradient' with 'Group' in the abstract corrects terminology rather than the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training sources, GUI-I/GUI-S/GUI-W evaluation coverage and AndroidWorld tasks. Appendix dataset descriptions and application coverage are retained.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 1, 2 and 5 are unchanged. The supplementary experiment using GPT-4o as the decision agent was already present in v1.

E3.justification: Table 4 revises the reported settings in rows 2 and 4 from format reward disabled and suggestion reward enabled to format reward enabled and suggestion reward disabled. This corrects the documented ablation configuration without establishing that experiments were rerun. Other evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 4 corrects which reward its existing ablations remove, aligning the displayed comparison with Section 4.3's suggestion-reward analysis. The other ablations, parameter sweeps and case studies remain; the Pro Expense example moves to Appendix B.3 rather than being added.

E5.justification: Neither version provides repeated-run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests. The new checklist answers 'Yes' to statistical-significance reporting but supplies no corresponding statistical information.

E6.justification: In the full-model rows of both Tables 3 and 4, GUI-I suggestion accuracy changes from 58.77 to 52.43 and GUI-S critic accuracy from 57.02 to 58.77, matching the unchanged Table 1. These are reporting corrections, not demonstrated performance improvements. Tables 1, 2 and 5 retain their numerical results.

T1.justification: The MDP formulation, data-selection expression, training objectives, reward definitions and GRPO mathematics are unchanged. No assumptions, theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: pre-operative GUI criticism, suggestion-aware optimization, the GUI-Critic datasets, and improved diagnostic and automation performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of generalization, efficiency and reward contributions remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the limitations concerning single-step visual input and the proposed extensions to smaller models and trajectory-level criticism.

D1.justification: The new checklist adds statements promising code release after acceptance and describing source datasets as available for noncommercial research. The release statements conflict with the retained abstract's code-available statement. Existing hyperparameters, hardware details and prompts are unchanged; an actual access change cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and research positioning are retained. The bibliography decreases from 58 to 57 entries by removing a duplicate Mobile-Agent-v2 reference; no distinct cited research work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 corrects the abstract's S-GRPO expansion, updates affiliations and publication information, adds acknowledgements and a checklist, and places references before the appendices. One case-study paragraph moves to Appendix B.3; most research prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: The Pro Expense illustration moves from main-text Figure 5 to appendix Figure 6, while the video example becomes Figure 5. Prompt Tables 6-9 are regrouped after Appendix D, and some figures are slightly resized or repositioned. The underlying visual content is retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting Tables 3-4 makes the full-model scores consistent with Table 1 and the reward ablations consistent with their stated purpose, improving the reliability of evidence for the central suggestion reward. These limited gains are partly offset by the new checklist's contradictory code-release statements, unsupported statistical-reporting assertion and unresolved reproducibility cross-reference.
